editorial:
You follow four young outsiders who teleport to a dangerous universe, and the trip changes their bodies in shocking ways. Their lives are turned upside down, and they must learn to control their new powers and work together to save Earth from a former friend who becomes an enemy. The movie has a dark, serious tone and focuses on how these characters deal with their new abilities. It feels more like a sci-fi drama than a bright superhero adventure, which may surprise you if you expect a fun, colorful comic book movie.

The acting is solid, especially from the young cast, and the special effects look good in the action scenes. The pacing is slow at first but picks up once the team starts working together. On the downside, the story feels rushed near the end and the villain is not very developed. If you enjoy darker superhero stories, you might like it. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the team faces their former friend, who has become a powerful enemy threatening Earth. They combine their abilities to stop him, learning to trust each other. The twist is that their victory comes at a cost, and the movie ends with them deciding to stay together as a team. You see them accept their new roles and prepare for future battles, setting up a possible sequel that never happened.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark superhero stories and sci-fi drama.
